rules.name: Momentum
rules.description: When charging, the unit has an A stat increased by 1

rules.name: Hunter Instinct
rules.description: When fighting single models or units with a Creature special rule, they do not subtract dice from the difference between Strength and Toughness

rules.name: Venom
rules.description: If an enemy unit is dealt a Wound during combat, the wounded base is removed. The rule does not apply to single models

rules.name: Sweeping Slash
rules.description: This unit can re-roll each score of 6 during the Weapon Skill Test

rules.name: Snake Move
rules.description: This unit can move or charge through enemy or friendly units if its move ends outside the unit that it was moving or charging through

rules.name: Toxic Spores
rules.description: When attacking a Trefloq, the enemy unit always has -1 to S

rules.name: Under the spell
rules.description: This unit can only be deployed if there is a Beast Master in the army. If the army loses its last Beast Master, roll a d6 before activating Wild Creatures. On a score of 5 or 6, the unit loses an Action Die. A different score means it can be activated normally

rules.name: Frenzy
rules.description: When charging, this unit doubles its Attacks (A) stat

rules.name: King of the Wild
rules.description: Each enemy unit within 10 cm of the Forest Dragon loses the horde rule if it has one. Each friendly Gaeldor unit within 10 cm has a Fearless rule

rules.name: Winged Creature
rules.description: After both armies are deployed, the Forest Dragon can be deployed up to 20 cm from its deployment zone

rules.name: Thick Hide
rules.description: For each Wound dealt to this model, roll a d6 for protection by Thick Hide. Each score of 1 means a cancelled Wound

rules.name: Roar
rules.description: Once per its turn, Marmydon may roll a d6. On a score of 2 or less, every enemy unit within 20 cm must take a Panic Test (4+) for two bases

rules.name: The Fall of the Leviathan
rules.description: If Marmydon loses its last W point, every unit or single model touching its base must roll 2d6. A score lower than LD means the enemy unit or model is dealt d6+2 Wounds with no armour or protection saves allowed

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Forest is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, make a d6 test before the fight. A score of 3 or less means the unit gets a +1 to S bonus in this cycle. The Champion of Forest allows to make a re-roll when rolling for terrain

rules.name: Druid
rules.description: Each friendly unit of Oduns and a Trefloq within 10 cm of the Druid can re-roll failed scores during the roll for protection (Woodiness)

rules.name: The Wrath of the Forest
rules.description: Basic and Elite Units in the Gaeldor army may change any 1 scored when moving or charging to a score of 3.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Roll a d6 if the General failed to issue an order to a unit of Amazons on Spiders, Forest Serpents, or Wild Creatures. A score of 4 or less means the General may re-roll the failed score. The Champion of Beasts attached to the listed units adds 2 more attacks to the pool

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Hunt is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, he can make a test whenever the friendly unit attacks. A score of 2 or less means every score of 6 in the Weapon Skill Test counts as a successful hit

rules.name: Eagle Talon
rules.description: Forged by the blacksmiths of the Iron Oaks, this legendary sword draws energy from the forces of nature. A unit that Mar'hauk is attached to can make 4 Wound Test re-rolls +1 re-roll for each terrain on the battlefield.

rules.name: Ern's Helm
rules.description: A Mar'hauk attached to a unit allows the unit to benefit from the power of his helm. After being dealt Wounds by an enemy unit, a friendly unit can take up to 5 save rolls if it has no save. Each score of 2 or less means a cancelled Wound.

rules.name: Mar'hauk
rules.description:
Mar'hauk can be fielded in the Gaeldor army regardless of the number of other heroes.

Mar'hauk rides a powerful creature called Vitur. Thanks to it, Mar'hauk supports the unit with 8 attacks. Mar'hauk has the items from the following list.

rules.name: Oaken Shield
rules.description: This legendary shield is anointed with resin from the ancient oaks of the Forgotten Reach. If an enemy unit comes into contact with Mar'hauk, it does not make a hero's death check and Mar'hauk may immediately be moved up to 20 cm of the enemy unit. This shield can only be used once per battle.

rules.name: Vitur
rules.description:
This creature's anger is unstoppable. The unit that Mar'hauk on Vitur is attached to has the Fear rule.

Fear – After a successful charge with this unit, the enemy must take a Panic Test for 1 base. If the unit is a horde, the enemy must take a Panic Test for 2 bases

rules.name: The Crusher
rules.description: This mysterious artifact hammer causes Pakun to support a unit with 6 attacks plus additional attacks equal to a d6 roll. Additionally, the unit Pakun supports changes its Strength (S) to 4 if it has less

rules.name: Dark Humour
rules.description: If Pakun is attached to the Half-giants unit, the unit may add or substract 1 from its LD during any test.

rules.name: Oklar
rules.description: An enemy unit that attacks a unit that Pakun is attached to must substract 3 dice from the pool.

sharedRules.name: Woodiness
sharedRules.description: For each Wound dealt to this unit, roll a d6 for protection. Each score of 1 means a cancelled Wound
